description: This file contains extension methods for working with lifecycle observers within the Orleans framework. It provides methods to subscribe to lifecycle events with various delegate signatures, supports diagnostic type naming, and manages lifecycle subscriptions including disposable registration and unregistration.

classes.name: LifecycleExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for ILifecycleObservable to facilitate subscribing to lifecycle events with various configurations.

methods.name: Subscribe
methods.description: Creates a disposable subscription to the lifecycle with start and optional stop delegates.

methods.name: Subscribe<TObserver>
methods.description: Creates a disposable subscription to the lifecycle with observer type used for diagnostics.

inner_classes.name: Observer
inner_classes.description: Internal class implementing ILifecycleObserver, used to wrap start and stop delegates.

inner_classes.name: StartupObserver
inner_classes.description: Internal class implementing ILifecycleObserver, used to create disposable startup registrations that auto-unsubscribe after start.

methods.name: Subscribe
methods.description: Creates a disposable subscription to the lifecycle with specified observer name, stage, and start/stop delegate functions.

methods.name: Subscribe
methods.description: Overload that creates a subscription with start delegate only.

methods.name: Subscribe
methods.description: Overload that creates a subscription with generic observer type for diagnostics.

methods.name: Subscribe
methods.description: Overload that creates a subscription with generic observer type, start delegate only.

methods.name: Subscribe
methods.description: Creates a subscription with an existing ILifecycleObserver.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method in StartupObserver used to create a disposable observer that auto-unsubscribes after startup.

methods.name: OnStart
methods.description: Method invoked during lifecycle start, invokes the provided delegate and disposes the registration if applicable.

methods.name: OnStop
methods.description: Method invoked during lifecycle stop, returns completed task.

methods.name: GetTypeName
methods.description: Helper to get full type name or fallback to type name for diagnostics.
